score: 10.8 s (DuckDB's optimizer 15.5 s; true sizes 10.4 s)
metric: Total DuckDB runtime of the 113 JOB queries on full IMDB with join trees and hash sides chosen by KumoSQL's DPccp optimizer from its own estimates; Postgres 16 estimates through the same optimizer 11.3 s. 30% faster than DuckDB's own plans, within 4% of plans from true sizes.
caveats: 4 threads, one container, best of two runs; queries take 10-700 ms so timing noise is a few percent. Families 1-16 seen during development.
correctness: All four plans of every query returned identical rows.
held_out: Families 17-33 (54 queries): 6.3 s against DuckDB's 8.4 s and true sizes' 6.2 s
